lines.text: 桥一断，库巴连一句狠话都没来得及说，就掉进了岩浆。
lines.en: The bridge snaps, and Bowser drops into the lava before he can finish a single threat.

lines.text: 这是超级玛丽 3D 的第四关，库巴城堡。
lines.en: This is World 1-4 in Super Mario 3D: Bowser's Castle.

lines.text: 前三关大家玩得差不多了，蓝天、地下、树冠。
lines.en: You've already played the first three worlds - sky, cave, treetops.

lines.text: 这次把最后一道门补上，菜单里起始关卡多了 1-4 城堡，从 1-3 拔旗也能直接接进来。
lines.en: This update adds the last door: the menu can start straight at 1-4 Castle, and finishing 1-3 rolls right into it.

lines.text: 一进来反差就很明显，背景基本是黑的，只有岩浆在发光。
lines.en: The contrast hits immediately - the background is basically black, only the lava glows.

lines.text: 地面是 160 列城堡石，台阶一格一格往下走。
lines.en: The floor is 160 columns of castle stone, with stairs stepping down one block at a time.

lines.text: 这一关埋了 4 处岩浆坑，掉下去就是一次失败。
lines.en: Four lava pits are hidden along the way; fall into one and that's a life gone.

lines.text: 走廊里 7 根火棒会转圈，转速和转向是我一帧一帧对原作录像调出来的。
lines.en: Seven fire bars spin down the corridor - I matched their speed and turning direction frame by frame against the original.

lines.text: 看准空当再过，硬闯必挨。
lines.en: Wait for the gap. Charging through always costs you.

lines.text: 喜欢这种火棒从面前扫过去的感觉，顺手点个赞。
lines.en: If you like watching a fire bar sweep past, tap that like button.

lines.text: 路上还有 6 块隐藏金币砖，这一趟顶到一块，金币从零变成一。
lines.en: Six hidden coin blocks are tucked in this level. I bonked one this run, so the coin counter goes from 0 to 1.

lines.text: 同一套路线，五种视角我都跑了一遍。
lines.en: I ran the exact same route in all five camera views.

lines.text: 正视在玛丽肩上，火棒扫过来最有压迫感。
lines.en: Over-the-shoulder is the most intense - the fire bars come straight at you.

lines.text: 再按一次 C 就是第一人称，火球直接糊到脸上，路基本看不清。
lines.en: Press C once more and you're in first person, where fireballs fill your face and the path basically disappears.

lines.text: 看个新鲜够用，真过关还得靠前面几个视角。
lines.en: Fun for a look; the earlier views are what actually clear the level.

lines.text: 最后是俯视，整段城堡的布局一眼看得清。
lines.en: The last preset is top-down, where the whole castle layout reads at a glance.

lines.text: 除了按 C 换预设，Q 和 E 还能自己转到任何角度。
lines.en: And besides C for presets, Q and E rotate the camera to any angle you want.

lines.text: 手机上是另一套操作，摇杆推到底就是跑，右下四个键，I 冲刺、J 火球、K 跳、U 蹲。
lines.en: On a phone it's a different control set: push the stick all the way to run, and the four buttons are I sprint, J fireball, K jump, U crouch.

lines.text: 竖着拿手机，菜单也会自动横过来，不用重开。
lines.en: Hold the phone vertically and the menu turns itself sideways - no restart needed.

lines.text: 这段就是摇杆和触屏键打下来的，中间被火棒蹭了两下，没摔死，照样通关。
lines.en: This stretch really was driven on the touchscreen. A fire bar clipped me twice, but no deaths, and it still cleared.

lines.text: 走廊尽头是库巴守着的吊桥，它会来回挪、会跳、还会吸气喷火。
lines.en: At the end of the corridor is the bridge Bowser guards - he paces, jumps, and inhales before breathing fire.

lines.text: 火球打它五下能现原形，不过更快的办法是别理它。
lines.en: Five fireballs reveal what he really is, but honestly the faster option is to just ignore him.

lines.text: 桥上方有一块来回走的浮台，连跳跳上去，从库巴头顶越过去碰斧头。
lines.en: A platform paces above the bridge. Double-jump onto it, go clean over Bowser's head and hit the axe.

lines.text: 斧头一碰，铁链断、桥塌，库巴掉进岩浆。
lines.en: Touch the axe and the chains snap, the bridge collapses, and Bowser falls.

lines.text: 然后蘑菇人告诉你，桥砍断了，可公主还在另一座城堡里。
lines.en: Then the toad tells you: the bridge is cut, but the princess is in another castle.

lines.text: 到这儿，1-1 到 1-4 就齐了，这一关四十六项机制测试全过，网站和 Toy 也已经是这个版本。
lines.en: That completes 1-1 through 1-4. All 46 mechanic tests pass, and the website and Toy builds are already on this version.

lines.text: 说明一下，这几段实机是脚本按验证过的路线驱动的，不是真人手操。
lines.en: One honest note: this footage is driven by a test script along a verified route, not played by hand.

lines.text: 路线是在同一个世界里用深度优先搜索试出来的，三百多个节点，一百三十六段零受伤。
lines.en: The route came out of a depth-first search inside the same world - a few hundred nodes, 136 segments, zero damage.

lines.text: 下一期要么继续往后做，要么按你们的投票来，投票页和试玩链接都在简介第一条。
lines.en: Next episode either keeps pushing forward or follows your votes - the voting page and the play link are the first lines of the description.

lines.text: 你要是也砍到了这座桥，评论区告诉我还剩多少时间。
lines.en: If you cut this bridge too, tell me in the comments how much time you had left.
